593556.Description: [Activate Main] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards and KO it. Then, if you have 8 or more energy, choose your Leader or up to 1 of your Battle Cards and it gets +30000 power for the turn.

593557.Description: [Activate Main] Choose all of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and switch them to Rest Mode. Then, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Rest Mode Battle Cards with costs of 4 or less and KO them.

593560.Description:
[Activate Main] Choose one—

•Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost 2 or less and KO it.

•If you removed an energy marker to use this card, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and KO them.

615549.Description:
[When Attacking] Discard 2 card from your hand : Unti the end of your opponent's next turn, this card can't be KO'd and gets +30000 power.
[Activate Main] [Once per turn] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with 25000 power or less and KO it. Then, KO this card.

615550.Description: [When Attacking] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, add up to 1 blue non-"Videl" card with a cost of 3 or less and "Earthling" in its special traits from your drop to your hand.

615552.Description:
[On Play] Add up to 1 card from your life to your hand.
[When Attacking] 1: Draw 1 card. Then, if you removed an energy marker for this skill, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with a cost of 4 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

627688.Description: [Activate Main] If your Leader has "Bardock's Crew" in its special traits, play up to 1 "Bardock" with a cost of 5 from your hand.

629021.Description: [On Play] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, choose up to 2 of your opponent's Battle Cards with costs of 3 or less and place them at the bottom of their owner's deck.
